name: Wizard Notes
author: Humanity Labs
description: Private-by-default plain Markdown notes, nested folders, linked thoughts and search.

form_fields.label: Trusted ingress hosts (optional)
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated host:port values. Blank uses the owner-authenticated Wizard ingress.

form_fields.label: Additional trusted browser origins (optional)
form_fields.hint: Same-host origins work automatically. Add exact origins only if needed.

form_fields.label: Vault folder (optional)
form_fields.hint: Absolute path of an existing folder on this Wizard, for example a synced Obsidian vault. Notes opens it instead of its own vault and saves files as the folder's owner. Blank keeps Notes' own vault.
form_fields.pattern_error: Use an absolute folder path such as /home/you/Obsidian Vault, without ':' or '$'.
